source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Include basic facts about the accident.
3. Describe the sequence of events.
4. Record witness statements.
5. Document injuries and first aid provided.
6. Identify immediate actions taken.
7. Confirm compliance with safety protocols.
8. Summarize the cause of the accident.
9. Detail corrective actions taken to prevent future incidents.
10. Attach any relevant photographs or diagrams.
11. Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of the report.
12. Complete and submit the report within the required timeframe.
13. Notify all necessary parties and authorities.
14. Store the report securely for future reference and possible legal requirements.

By following this step-by-step guide, you will be able to accurately document workplace accidents, ensuring that all necessary details are recorded and compliant with company policies and legal requirements.<|end_of_text|>
